d: Jose Mourinho has certainly raised a few eyebrows with what he's said about Vinicius Junior. The suggestion is simple, maybe the Real Madrid forward would have been better off leaving the club and going somewhere else, somewhere rival fans and stadiums would actually respect him. This comes after the racism controversy involving Gianluca Prestianni, and in the middle of what has been a pretty turbulent spell for Vinicius at Real Madrid. Naturally, it's put his relationship with his coach under the scanner all over again. So what does Mourinho's intervention really mean for the La Liga…
